messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: Elevated embeddings QPS detected on pool 'embeds-hot' (GPU util 92%). Errors: 5xx spike for embeddings, chat latencies increasing. Paging @kevin-m for mitigation.

kevin-m: ack, looking now. link to dashboards: https://redwood.monitor/embeds-hot (graphs show sustained 3x qps for ~9m)

kevin-m: quick triage: spike appears multi-tenant; rerank jobs are backpressuring same pool. autoscale not keeping up due to long KV cache warming.

marta: can we apply a per-route soft throttle and disable non-critical rerank routes? Suggest: embeddings route -> 50% per-endpoint qps; rerank-public -> disabled until healthy.

kevin-m: ok applying soft limits now.

```
# soft mitigation commands (ops-runner)
redwoodctl route update --route embeds-hot --limit-qps 6 --reason "live mitigation 1769805432"
redwoodctl route update --route rerank-public --enabled=false --reason "live mitigation 1769805432"
```

incident-bot: Change applied: embeds-hot limit_qps=6 by kevin-m; rerank-public enabled=false by kevin-m.

sylvia: I also carved a tenant-level cap for "searchly" (they accounted for 40% of the spike)

```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant searchly --route embeds-hot --limit-qps 0.5 --reason "mitigate noisy neighbor"
```

kevin-m: monitoring: GPU util dropped to ~65% in 4m, embeddings 5xx rate down from 18% -> 2%, chat p95 latency improving. Good signal.

susan: any customer-facing impact? Have we notified affected customers/CS?

support-team: notified via status page and opened tickets for top 3 impacted tenants (searchly, startup-a, data-hub). Support has initial templates ready.

kevin-m: note: two enterprise tenants still show job-driven surges (large batch embeddings). Reached out to acct teams to pause those jobs; asking SRE to throttle their API keys if needed.

marta: follow-up items: (1) postmortem and add automated per-tenant caps for embeds when pool util > 85%, (2) consider circuit-breaker to auto-disable rerank-public beyond util threshold, (3) validate autoscaler warm-up behavior for large KV caches.

kevin-m: created incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-1769805432 and ticket CH-1234 for follow-ups. Mitigation window set for 2h.

oncall-next: ack, I'll take over monitoring for the next 2h and will escalate if we see another spike.

kevin-m: handoff at 1769805800 to @oncall-next. Rollback plan:

```
# rollback if stable
redwoodctl route update --route rerank-public --enabled=true --reason "rollback after mitigation"
redwoodctl route update --route embeds-hot --limit-qps 12 --reason "restore baseline"
```

oncall-next: ack, monitoring dashboards and logs. Will post updates if anything changes.

kevin-m: closing my active page. Will follow up on postmortem with concrete SLOs and per-route rules. :thumbsup:
